parallel_workers.coordination_contract: Each worker should reread newest ClayCode commits/in-progress artifacts before Fusion 2 and before final write; ingest sibling deltas with provenance and avoid counting shared ancestry as independent evidence.

primary_scope: realistic capability-boundary red-team design and executable host-side checker
effect-time semantic validation and capability attenuation

handoff_policy.before_fusion2: reread newest repository commits and ingest all new ClayCode worker deltas
handoff_policy.before_finalization: repeat worker scan; preserve contradictions; merge only non-duplicative deltas
handoff_policy.promotion: none without independent evidence and validation
